title: System Breach v2.0
game_overview: Challenging cyberpunk arcade platformer with 3 sectors, multi-phase bosses, timed laser grids, moving platforms, Cyber Blaster combat, S-Rank arcade scoring, and unlockable Time Attack.
winning_condition: Clear all 3 sectors and purge the CORE-OMEGA mainframe boss.
losing_condition: Player health drops to 0 from hazards or enemies.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Multi-Stage Jump: Standard grounded leap with smooth mid-air double jump emitting digital particle pulses. 2. Collision & Movement: Snappy AABB physics with dedicated slope/ledge tolerances, coyote time (0.12s), and jump buffering (0.1s) for zero input lag. 3. Data Decryption Scoring: Collectible data fragments boosting score. 4. Dynamic Hazard Patrols: Predictable drone patrol arcs and timed laser grids with fair telegraphing. 5. Checkpoint Terminals: Working physical checkpoints that reliably preserve level progress and HP upon respawn.
sections.summary: Acrobatic hacker movement and interactive systems.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Modular state machine architecture: 1. Main Menu with animated cyber backdrop, Play, Level Select, and How to Play/Tutorial modal. 2. In-Game Pause System (ESC / Pause icon) allowing instantaneous Resume, Restart, or Return to Title. 3. Three distinct playable levels with validated win paths: Level 1 (Firewall Perimeter - Introductory platforming & basic drones), Level 2 (Subroutine Core - Moving platforms, laser traps, dual checkpoints), Level 3 (Mainframe Breach - Advanced drone gauntlet, descending hazards, final portal breach). 4. Victory Screen with stats recap and direct replay options.
sections.summary: Seamless menu, pause flow, tutorial, and modular 3-level progression.
